en: Sepia-toned image of an arched cloister or courtyard inside a historic college building. The view shows a covered walkway with thick columns and vaulted ceilings, looking onto an inner courtyard with potted plants and trees. Several children or students in dark clothing stand and walk along the corridor. At the bottom margin is a printed caption indicating the location and institution.
